zh: 把争议放回证据里：立场光谱与视角对照矩阵
en: Put the dispute back on the evidence
dz: 同一场气候争议中，不同发言者有不同立场和专业背景。学生通过立场光谱与视角对照矩阵，分别比较他们的意见、相关专长和所提供的证据。
de: Students compare speakers in a climate dispute using a position spectrum and a perspective matrix, distinguishing their views, relevant expertise and evidence.

zh: 当 AI 重写历史：历史图像的证据核查
en: When AI rewrites history
fz: AI 时代历史图像核查
dz: 一张历史照片附带的文字可能包含多项需要核实的信息。学生分别检查照片来源、人物身份、故事细节和背景史实，再判断哪些内容有证据。
de: Students check the source, identities, story details and historical context of a photograph, identifying which claims the evidence supports.

zh: 信息筛选方法：从 CRAAP 到 CRRAAB
en: The filter: from CRAAP to CRRAAB
dz: 可靠的材料也可能与当前问题无关。学生比较 CRAAP 与 CRRAAB 的检查方法，练习同时判断来源是否可靠、内容是否能回答研究问题。
de: Students compare CRAAP and CRRAAB to assess both source reliability and whether a source can answer their research question.

zh: 科学否认的五种手法：用 FLICC 拆两段气候视频
en: Five moves of science denial: FLICC
fz: 科学传播与否认手法识别
dz: 学生用 FLICC 分析两段观点不同的气候视频，检查双方是否存在选择性使用证据等问题，并说明判断的依据。
de: Students use FLICC to examine two climate videos with different positions, checking both for selective evidence and explaining their judgments.

zh: 一张图，四次史料评估：OPCVL 史料评估
en: One image, four reversals: OPCVL
dz: 以一张 1915 年英国征兵海报为例，学生在了解作者、出版者及收藏背景后，逐次修订对史料价值与局限的判断。
de: Students reassess the value and limitations of a 1915 British recruitment poster as they learn about its creator, publisher and archival context.

zh: 事实、观点，还是价值判断？
en: Fact, opinion, or value judgment?
fe: Types of claim, and how to answer them
dz: 区分事实、观点与价值判断，有助于选择合适的核查方法。学生练习检查事实的范围与样本、观点的理由，以及价值判断所采用的标准。
de: Students distinguish facts, opinions and value judgments, then choose appropriate checks: scope and samples, reasons, or evaluative criteria.

zh: 信息交互能力工具包
en: The information-handling toolkit
dz: 围绕长滩岛是否应开设赌场，学生整理旅游收入、环境承载、治理能力与社区利益等信息，比较各方关注的问题及方案之间的取舍。
de: Students examine a proposed casino on Boracay through tourism income, environmental capacity, governance and community interests, comparing priorities and trade-offs.

zh: 信息素养：从一项权威说法到多源核查写作
en: From one authoritative claim to verified writing
dz: 从威尼斯短租争议中的一段发言出发，学生明确需要验证的具体说法，再通过多个来源核查，将证据用于写作。
de: Students identify specific claims in a statement about short-term rentals in Venice, check multiple sources and use the evidence in writing.

zh: 元认知：检查自己的判断过程
en: Metacognition: how do I know I haven't fooled myself?
dz: 学生回顾自己形成判断的过程，检查推理前提、缺少的推理步骤，以及尚未考虑的经验和视角。
de: Students review how they reached a judgment, checking premises, missing reasoning steps and perspectives they have not considered.

zh: 可比性检验：先查四格，再判断
en: Comparability check: four boxes before you judge
fz: 证据可比性与冲突判断
sys: Biology IA · AP Statistics · 数学 · 生物
dz: 面对结论不同的两篇论文，学生先比较研究对象、数据构成、范围尺度和测量方法，再判断结论是否真的冲突。
de: Before deciding that two papers conflict, students compare their subjects, data, scope and measurement methods.

zh: 哥伦布：英雄还是恶棍？OPCVL 多源综合
en: Columbus: hero or villain? OPCVL across sources
dz: 学生阅读有关哥伦布的不同史料，检查记录者、写作对象、目的与背景，并比较各份材料能帮助回答什么问题。
de: Students assess sources about Columbus by examining authorship, audience, purpose and context, then compare the questions each source can help answer.

zh: SIFT 信息横向调查：从一条微信到一篇有立场的议论文
en: SIFT lateral reading: from a post to an argued essay
fz: 学术写作与可持续议题论证
fe: Academic writing on a sustainability question
dz: 一条公众号推文说：NASA 发现地球在变绿，源头在中国和印度。要不要写进论文？横向核查追回一手来源，再回头看转述与原文之间差了什么，最后写成一篇有立场、有证据的议论文。
de: A post claims NASA found the Earth greening, and that China and India are why. Does it go in the essay? Read laterally back to the primary source, see what the retelling lost on the way, and write it up as an essay that takes a position and can defend it.

zh: 威尼斯三选一：依据纪录片材料提出建议
en: Venice, three options: a defensible recommendation
fz: 纪录片材料到建议写作
fe: From documentary material to a recommendation
dz: 围绕威尼斯的过度旅游问题，学生比较限制邮轮、管理短租和协助搬迁三个方案，运用纪录片中的材料提出建议并解释取舍。
de: Students compare three responses to overtourism in Venice, using documentary evidence to recommend a policy and explain its trade-offs.

zh: 英文学术写作：从论文结构到引用规范
en: Academic writing in English: structure to citation
dz: 学生练习规划英文学术论文的结构、组织段落、规范引用，并说明 AI 的使用方式，逐项检查自己的稿件。
de: Students plan an academic essay, develop paragraphs, check citations and describe their use of AI as they review their draft.

zh: 我们能多确定？证据语言的校准
en: How sure can we be? Calibrating the language of evidence
dz: 拿 Haltinner 与 Sarathchandra 关于气候怀疑者分类的论文当案例，读的不是「作者发现了什么」，而是「作者对每个发现有多大把握」——suggests、indicates、demonstrates，确定度就藏在措辞里。
de: Using Haltinner and Sarathchandra's paper on types of climate scepticism, the reading is not “what did they find” but “how sure are they of each finding”. Suggests, indicates, demonstrates: the certainty is in the wording.

zh: 检查数据呈现：数据三问
en: When numbers want to fool you: three questions
sys: Math AI · AP Statistics · 数学
dz: 学生检查坐标轴、比较对象、分母和时间区间，分析数据呈现方式如何影响读者的判断，即使数字本身真实也需要核查。
de: Students examine axes, comparison groups, denominators and time intervals to understand how data presentation can influence interpretation.

zh: 数据分析：从研究问题到结果段落
en: Data analysis: from question to results paragraph
sys: 各科 IA · AP Research · 数学
dz: 学生从研究问题出发选择分析方法和图表，再根据结果撰写解释，检查每一项分析是否回答了原先的问题。
de: Students choose methods and charts based on a research question, interpret the results and check whether each analysis addresses that question.

zh: 查找信息：从搜索入口到可用资源
en: Finding information: from the search box to a usable source
sys: EE 研究过程 · EPQ · 信息技术
dz: 查资料不是定题时做一次的事。它贯穿推进、写作和修改，而且每个阶段要的资料不一样：早期用来理解方向，中期用来建立证据，写作时用来核查。
de: Finding sources is not something you do once, when choosing a topic. It runs through drafting, writing and revision, and each stage wants a different kind: early on to understand the ground, later to build evidence, at the end to check.

zh: 识别企业漂绿：Tesla ESG 证据链
en: Spotting greenwashing: the Tesla ESG evidence chain
dz: 以 Tesla 影响力报告为例，学生将环境相关表述拆成可核查的问题，并结合其他来源检查环境、社会与治理方面的证据。
de: Using Tesla’s impact report, students formulate checkable questions and compare evidence across environmental, social and governance issues.

zh: 生成式 AI 时代的多模态信息甄别与可信判断
en: Judging multimodal information in the age of generative AI
fz: AI 生成多模态信息可信判断
sys: Digital Society · TOK · 信息技术
dz: 学生分别练习核查报告、图片与视频：查阅机构原文，检查图片来源与元数据，并结合时间、地点和上下文验证视频内容。
de: Students practise checking reports, images and videos using original sources, provenance, metadata and contextual evidence about time and place.

zh: 电竞是不是体育？
en: Is esports a sport?
dz: 「IOC 承认电竞是体育」和「德国拒绝把电竞叫作体育」可以同时为真，因为它们说的不是同一件事。有的机构在做行政分类，有的在认可一个组织，有的只是在自己的运动会里设了一个项目。
de: “The IOC recognises esports as sport” and “Germany refuses to call esports sport” can both be true, because they are not saying the same thing. One body is classifying for administration, another is recognising an organisation, a third merely added an event to its own games.

zh: 研究方法：从问题到可执行计划
en: Research methods: from question to a workable plan
sys: EE/IA 方法 · AP Research · 综合实践
dz: 方法不是论文里那段格式化的文字，它是结论可信度的来源。这门课把方法从「我用了什么工具」推到「为什么这样取证、怎样分析、结论能说到哪里」。
de: Method is not the formatted paragraph in the paper; it is where a conclusion's credibility comes from. The course pushes it from “what tools I used” to why the evidence was gathered this way, how it was analysed, and how far the conclusion can reach.

zh: 影像侦探局：镜头在替谁说话
en: The image detective: whose side is the camera on?
sys: Film · Lang&Lit P1 · 语文跨媒介
dz: 这门课不判断气候问题谁对谁错，它处理另一件事：你看完一段影像之后冒出来的那个判断，有多少来自证据，有多少来自光线、构图和配乐。
de: The course does not rule on who is right about the climate. It handles something else: the judgment that surfaces after you watch a film — how much of it came from the evidence, and how much from the lighting, the framing and the score.

zh: 如何写出有效的让步段
en: A concession you can delete was never a concession
sys: Lang A P2 · AP Lang · 语文
dz: 学生检查让步段是否回应了相关的反方证据，以及这些证据是否需要限定或调整自己的论点。
de: Students check whether a concession addresses relevant counterevidence and whether that evidence calls for qualifications or changes to their argument.

zh: 逻辑侦探局：从拆案到立案的论证训练
en: The logic detective: taking arguments apart and building them
dz: 从一句听起来很顺的话开始，让学生短暂地被说服，再回头追问：它是靠证据把我说服的，还是靠人数、恐惧、权威、偷换概念、极端选项把我推过去的。
de: It starts with a sentence that goes down easily, lets the student be persuaded for a moment, then turns back on it: was I convinced by the evidence, or pushed there by numbers, fear, authority, a switched term, or a false choice?

zh: 语言如何塑造思维：五把工具扫描文本框定
en: How language shapes thought: five tools for reading framing
sys: TOK 语言主题 · AP Lang · 语文
dz: 先做实验：同一组犯罪数据，一半学生读到「犯罪是野兽」，一半读到「犯罪是病毒」。给出的方案明显分岔——一边抓捕惩戒，一边诊断干预。在自己身上看见这件事发生，比听十遍「语言会影响判断」有用。
de: An experiment first: the same crime data, half the class told crime is a beast, half told it is a virus. The solutions split visibly — capture and punish on one side, diagnose and treat on the other. Watching it happen to yourself beats being told ten times that language steers judgment.

zh: 追踪信息背后的利益链
en: Following the money behind a claim
fz: 利益链与资金来源核查
dz: 有人转给你一条视频：CO₂ 不是污染物，化石燃料把全球人均寿命从 30 岁推到 73 岁，所以减排是在阻碍文明。有数据、有图表、听起来挺有道理——那就顺着钱追下去，看这条论证是谁出钱说的。
de: Someone sends you a video: CO₂ is not a pollutant, fossil fuels took life expectancy from 30 to 73, so cutting emissions holds civilisation back. It has data, charts and a certain plausibility. So follow the money, and find out who paid for the argument.

zh: 选题与 Proposal：从宽泛兴趣到可写研究提案
en: Topic and proposal: from a broad interest to a writable question
fe: Choosing a topic, writing a proposal
sys: EE 开题 · AP Research · 综合实践
dz: 「我想研究人工智能对就业的影响」——这不是研究问题，是一个话题。这门课处理从话题到问题那一段最难走的路：缩范围、找角度、定出一个真的能用材料回答的问句。
de: “I want to research AI's effect on employment” is not a research question; it is a topic. This course walks the hardest stretch of the road — narrowing, finding an angle, and landing on a question that material can actually answer.

zh: 项目管理：把长期探究变成一周冲刺
en: Project management: a long inquiry as weekly sprints
sys: EE/CAS · EPQ log · 综合实践
dz: 学生把长期研究拆成可执行的阶段和每周任务，记录选择、任务依赖及风险，并根据进展调整计划。
de: Students divide a long-term inquiry into stages and weekly tasks, track decisions, dependencies and risks, and adjust their plan as work progresses.

zh: 问得好，AI 才会答得妙：提示词如何写
en: Ask well and the AI answers well: writing prompts
fz: AI 提问与提示词设计
dz: 很多学生以为提示词写得好，就是把角色、语气和格式堆得更长。这门课先让学生拿一件真实要做的事问一次 AI：先预测，再看回答，再打开原始来源核查。最关键的发现是：人为什么会在流畅笃定的回答面前，不自觉地交出判断权。
de: Students tend to think a better prompt is a longer one — more role, more tone, more format. Here they ask about something they actually have to do: predict the answer, read it, then open the sources and check. The finding that matters is not that AI errs, but why fluent, confident prose quietly takes your judgment away.

zh: 你身体里的小队：IFS 内在部分与注意力审计
en: The team inside you: IFS parts and an attention audit
dz: 这门课把 IFS 的核心语言转成青少年能用的「内在剧组」。不做心理测试，不做诊断，也不劝学生少玩手机。它做的是更基础的一件事：把「我就是很焦虑」改写成「我有一个部分很焦虑」——这一句改写，就是从台上回到观众席。
de: IFS translated into a cast of inner characters a teenager can use. No test, no diagnosis, no lecture about screen time. It does something more basic: it rewrites “I am anxious” into “a part of me is anxious” — and that one rewrite moves you from the stage back into the audience.

zh: 向内探索：三个视角与变革免疫地图
en: Looking inward: three perspectives and immunity to change
fz: 主客体转换与变革免疫
fe: Subject-object shift and immunity to change
dz: 课程以凯根的主客体转换与变革免疫模型为底座，但刻意不做阶段排名，不给自测，也不给个人视角判定。它只帮学生看清一件事：我嘴上想要的改变，和我实际在保护的东西，是不是同一个。
de: Built on Kegan's subject-object shift and immunity to change, but deliberately without stage rankings, self-tests or verdicts on a person. It helps a student see one thing only: whether the change she says she wants and the thing she is actually protecting are the same.

zh: AI 公司的「焚书坑儒」
en: Who paid for the AI?
fz: 谁为 AI 付了账：AI 伦理
fe: Who paid for the AI: AI ethics
dz: 一段关于 Anthropic 的短视频，把 AI 训练数据、版权、劳动和能源放在一起，很容易直接得出「AI 公司牺牲了很多人」。这门课不要求学生先站队，而是从一个更简单的问题开始：这笔账，究竟是谁在付？
de: A short video about Anthropic puts training data, copyright, labour and energy in one frame, and it is easy to land straight on “AI companies sacrifice a lot of people”. The course does not ask you to take a side first. It starts from a simpler question: who is actually paying?
